semantic_readback.inputs: Paired X(N×G) and Y(N×T), common cell rows; optional categorical batch S.
semantic_readback.posterior: q(z|x,y,s), q(l|x,y,s), q(beta|z,s); posterior mean z for cell analysis is distinct from z sample to decoder.
semantic_readback.decoder: z sample and s parameterize rho, alpha, pi; l and beta are latent nuisance quantities; theta[g] and phi[t] are feature-specific dispersion parameters.
semantic_readback.likelihood: RNA NB(mean=l*rho, inverse dispersion theta); protein mixture BG mean beta, FG mean beta*alpha, shared phi; pi=Pr(BG).
semantic_readback.outputs: Three overview/cell-level uses and all four named feature-level tasks preserved. Background decoupling, batch correction, missing-protein imputation and differential expression are distinct posterior queries, not four direct numeric outputs of a likelihood node.
semantic_readback.conditions: Denoised foreground expression involves E_q[(1−pi)*beta*alpha] with stated batch treatment. Missing protein prediction is conditional inference, not a physical measurement. Embedding/grid/distribution marks are schematic.
semantic_readback.alpha_conflict: Prose alpha>1 versus Algorithm ReLU+1/[1,infinity) remains unresolved. Separately specified BG/FG mean parameters need not always differ numerically.
